$comment: Platform preference (card x5wnfcg). redMainHold on|off: while main's CI is red the drain contains it (tool override env WE_DRAIN_RED_MAIN_HOLD). redMainMode stop|quarantine: stop = only the main-fix PR(s) land, others held red-main-hold; quarantine = known failing tests skipped via ops/quarantine and other PRs keep landing (OFF until its red-team review; tool override env WE_DRAIN_RED_MAIN_MODE). See scripts/lib/red-main-hold.mjs and scripts/lib/red-main-quarantine.mjs. redMainQuarantine cascade: unitJobPattern matches vitest jobs (default test-shard, integration, soak-shard); derivedJobs are aggregators (test, daemon-soak). maxTests caps live files plus additions (5); ttlMin is expiry minutes (360, at most 24h). requireProvenFlake (boolean, true; WE_RED_MAIN_QUARANTINE_REQUIRE_PROVEN_FLAKE on|off) requires a green rerun of the failing commit (a green merge group is never proof: it tested its queued PR's changes). fileCardPerEntry (boolean, true; WE_RED_MAIN_QUARANTINE_FILE_CARD_PER_ENTRY on|off) records one owed repair card per entry. Each key resolves standard → platform → this redMainQuarantine block → WE_RED_MAIN_QUARANTINE_* env; TTL_MIN, MAX_TESTS, UNIT_JOB_PATTERN, DERIVED_JOBS override the corresponding keys.
